what.value: Excursion closing substrate-2's commit-coverage freshness gap so the 'live' predicate holds for commit vertices as well as watched files.
what.quote: `M-live-geometric-stack` ships var/test/namespace coverage as **real-time** (multi-watcher, ~5s polling) and commit coverage as **manual-batch** (operator runs `bb scripts/ingest_commits_to_futon1a.clj` per repo).
